prompt_serialization: frozen system prompt, two LF bytes, exact materialized context
session_isolation: --ephemeral; one fresh Codex invocation per run

worktree_architecture.checkout: shallow pinned checkout with blob filtering where supported

status_capture: git status --porcelain=v1 before and after the model run
patch_capture_failure: INFRA_FAILURE only when the final full worktree cannot be represented reliably
test_discovery: TESTS_EXECUTED, NO_TESTS_RAN, and TEST_EXECUTION_STATUS are recorded separately

network.dependency_setup: pinned checkout/cache preparation may require network before the agent call

retry_policy: retry infrastructure failures with no usable output; never retry a usable coding result
statistical_design: 7 tasks x 3 arms x 3 repetitions = 63 fresh V2 Codex runs
